The jaguar ad WAS weird ok - not a single car, baaki sab theek hai but gaadi toh dikhao

I think JLR is just using Jaguar’s brand reputation as a launchpad. Jaguar has had tanking sales for while. JLR has no stable electric platform/brand.
So they are “reinventing” the whole thing, but keeping the brand name for familiarity.
Similar to what HMD tried by buying the Nokia brand and launching Android phones

They have solid products imho - the I-PACE is easily my favorite EV, only too expensive. There is plenty they can do and it’s perfectly ok to appeal to new demographics and be more inclusive but it has to be around the product, that is the ultimate telos.
